purpose: Research registry of external G2P/IPA comparator systems and IPA/source-script display fonts. Entries are not active runtime dependencies; system smoke results are not pronunciation gold data.

integration_contract.pipeline: source orthography -> language-specific structural/phonological analysis -> typed IPA result -> ClippyFirst IPA-to-Ukrainian adapter -> practical Ukrainian orthography
prohibited: silently rewriting external output into IPA without a documented conversion
using unverified output as gold data

benchmark_protocol.scoring_gate: Only independently adjudicated, non-empty gold_ipa rows are scored.
benchmark_protocol.notes: Registry membership does not establish language support, IPA output semantics, reproducibility, accuracy, or license compatibility. Preserve raw output and record exact versions and model/data licenses.

observed_experiments.interpretation: The source-attested entries are explicitly not independently adjudicated gold; output symbols must be checked against this project's IPA convention.

observed_experiments.notes: 6 raw outputs. Output is a list of phone tokens. Source-attested IPA comparison is not scored; e.g. stress/syllable separators in `ភ្នំពេញ` are not represented in token output, but this is a convention difference to review, not automatically a phonological error.

upstream_evidence.fact: Upstream describes MIT-licensed standalone Khmer G2P and returns word tokens plus phoneme tokens.
upstream_evidence.caveat: Some phone sequences may be IPA-like; do not assume full convention parity or lexical accuracy.

upstream_evidence.fact: Upstream describes a 29,204-entry IPA pronunciation dictionary validated by native linguists; README says dictionary data is CC BY-SA 4.0, distinct from MIT code/model.
upstream_evidence.caveat: Not integrated or redistributed. Need inspect exact release/files, dialect/annotation convention and licensing before use.

upstream_evidence.fact: README lists Khmer Central among supported languages and claims IPA phone set.
upstream_evidence.caveat: Khmer Central may not match project's exact target profile; validate dialect and IPA conventions.

scope_note: Historical filename: this registry catalogs both external G2P/IPA comparison systems and display fonts. Fonts are rendering assets, not pronunciation engines.

status_semantics.verified_in_repo: true means the candidate's pronunciation behavior has been validated against project-approved independent gold. A successful smoke or upstream language-support claim does not set this flag.
status_semantics.execution_status: Records whether a candidate was run, blocked, or only reported upstream; it is independent of verified_in_repo.
